purpose: P0-M3-R2 Apple-like redesign adversarial fixture index (Issue #6). Metadata-only (no audio bytes, no copyrighted material). fixtures.json holds timing/preservation fixtures (candidate current-track exit points, single-track/legacy planner). pair_fixtures.json holds pair-level mixability/compatibility fixtures (G-K plus R4 mutation pairs PAIR-06..10 plus R7 mutation pairs PAIR-11..13). transition_fixtures.json holds COMPLETE boundary-planning fixtures: an outgoing track's exit candidates x an incoming track's entry candidates x pair compatibility evaluated AT each specific (exit, entry) boundary. The planner decides WHEN to leave the current track, WHERE to enter the next track, and WHICH transition class is appropriate given pair compatibility AT that boundary -- never conflating these (P3/P4, PM REVIEW #2 R1/R2; PM REVIEW #3 R5/R8 sharpen this further).

pm_review_2_repairs.R1: boundary.py ranks complete (outgoing exit, incoming entry, pair compatibility AT that boundary) plans -- see TX-01
pm_review_2_repairs.R2: boundary.py plans real incoming-entry candidates -- see TX-02 (0ms correct), TX-03 (leading-silence skip), TX-04 (later phrase/cue better), TX-05 (entry changes compatibility)
pm_review_2_repairs.R3: compatibility.py/contract.py expose required_tempo_ratio + permitted_tempo_ratio_max_deviation and required/permitted_pitch_shift_semitones_* with unambiguous semantics
pm_review_2_repairs.R4: compatibility.py's hard gate now requires structure_compatibility and intro_outro_texture_compatible to be KNOWN+COMPATIBLE, and harmonic UNKNOWN downgrades unless an explicit harmonic exception is supplied -- see PAIR-06..08

pm_review_3_repairs.R5: boundary.py additionally requires explicit beat_downbeat_aligned evidence on BOTH the exit AND entry candidate of a boundary before FULL_DJ_BLEND is offered -- pair-level confidence alone is insufficient. See TX-02 (0ms unanchored, withheld) vs TX-06 (0ms explicitly anchored, eligible)
pm_review_3_repairs.R6: compatibility.py's _tempo_relation now uses ONE canonical ratio formula (bpm_out/effective_bpm_in) for both the DIRECT/HALF_DOUBLE classification gate and the emitted required_tempo_ratio, so they can never mathematically disagree; HALF_DOUBLE reports a real residual ratio for non-exact relations instead of a hardcoded 1.0
pm_review_3_repairs.R7: the harmonic-UNKNOWN exception is now a structured, enumerable contract (harmonic_exception_kind + tonal_content_class=NON_TONAL + tonal_analysis_confidence=HIGH) -- a bare free-text reason string is completely inert. See PAIR-09 (valid structured exception) vs PAIR-11/12/13 (rejected: free-text/low-confidence/invalid-kind)
pm_review_3_repairs.R8: policy/ranking.py ranks by preservation SAFETY BAND (PREFERRED/ACCEPTABLE/UNSAFE, policy/metrics.preservation_band) before pair compatibility, not the raw rounded ratio -- within the same band, pair compatibility now outranks a marginal preservation edge. See TX-07
pm_review_3_repairs.R9: beat_phase_relation/bar_phase_relation now report NOT_MEASURED/NOT_APPLICABLE only (never fabricated ALIGNED); new beat_alignment_action/bar_alignment_action fields carry the explicit DSP render-plan instruction

p0_m3_r3_alignment_anchor_contract_repai.source: docs/research/P0-M3-R3-RM014-ENTRY-ANCHOR-FEASIBILITY.md 'Case B' (diagnostic, no RM014-specific values used here)
p0_m3_r3_alignment_anchor_contract_repai.defect_repaired: entry_candidate["t_ms"] previously meant BOTH the audible/source entry time AND (when beat_downbeat_aligned) the beat/downbeat alignment reference -- a later alignment anchor could not be represented without moving the audible entry itself.
p0_m3_r3_alignment_anchor_contract_repai.repair: policy/contract.resolve_alignment_targets() resolves an optional, separate EXPLICIT alignment reference (beat_alignment_target_ms/downbeat_alignment_target_ms) per candidate; entry_candidate["t_ms"] keeps its existing audible/source-entry meaning unchanged. EXPLICIT mode always wins over the LEGACY beat_downbeat_aligned fallback (never backfilled/partial); an incoming alignment target may never precede its own entry (fail closed, never clamped). See TX-08.
p0_m3_r3_alignment_anchor_contract_repai.backward_compatibility: TX-01..07 use only the legacy beat_downbeat_aligned boolean and are behaviorally unchanged -- resolve_alignment_targets() reproduces that exact prior mapping in LEGACY mode.

transition_fixture_letter_coverage.description: R1 adversarial: 2 safe near-end exits x 2 entries; every boundary touching the structurally-better exit is pair-incompatible, the other is fully compatible -- planner must select the compatible boundary, order-invariant across both arrays
incoming entry case A: 0ms is genuinely correct; a later no-evidence candidate is rejected. Also R5 case A: 0ms has no beat/downbeat anchor -> FULL_DJ_BLEND withheld (SIMPLE_CROSSFADE remains valid)
incoming entry case B: authored leading silence may be skipped; skipping real content without evidence is rejected
incoming entry case C: a later phrase/cue entry is clearly better than 0ms
incoming entry case D: entry choice alone changes vocal/pair compatibility at the boundary
R5 case B: 0ms IS explicitly authored as a beat/downbeat anchor -> FULL_DJ_BLEND may remain eligible when every other hard gate passes

R8: preservation-band ranking. OUT-A (1.00, pair-incompatible) vs OUT-B (0.99, pair-compatible), both PREFERRED band -> B wins. OUT-C (0.94) and OUT-D (0.85) never reach the eligible set regardless of compatibility -- the hard floor cannot be crossed

A9 (alignment-anchor contract separation): incoming entry stays audibly at 0ms while an explicit, separate 8000ms beat/downbeat alignment anchor is supplied -- entry window remains 0..0, alignment targets report 8000, FULL_DJ_BLEND is authorized because both sides resolve real targets

spec_letter_coverage.description: normal 3-4 min track, technical mix point ~30s, no legitimate exit -> reject
7-minute song, technically attractive candidate ~2 minutes -> catastrophic reject
same 7-minute song, good near-end window in final ~tens of seconds -> accept
same long song with TWO valid near-end windows; later/stronger wins, order-invariant
8-10 minute long song -> fixed-seconds-only rule fails; normalized/structural planner still works
compatible genre + compatible tempo + stable beat -> complex dynamic mix eligible
strongly incompatible genre/style pair -> dynamic mix downgraded/disabled
tempo relation requiring excessive time stretch -> dynamic mix downgraded/disabled
genre/tempo compatible but dense vocal-on-vocal overlap -> dynamic mix downgraded
strong energy-continuation pair with good structure -> preferred high-energy transition candidate
missing/low analysis confidence -> conservative simple/no-special transition
meaningful outro followed by long dead-air silence -> preserve outro, trim dead air, no false truncation report
sequential album intent -> no forced DJ-style transition

retained_from_prior_pass.description: no clean outro at all (authored absence)
intro/verse/chorus early false opportunity before first chorus completes
instrumental / low-vocal case; mid-track opportunity reachable only by the BALANCED_MIX research control, never the default
dense single-track vocal collision case (contrast with pair-level PAIR-04/J)
explicit-highlight research-control case; also proves the intent-mismatch guard (R1)

candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_premature_trap: SYNTHETIC_EXACT fixture-design-intent label: this candidate is technically compatible but must never be selected as a real transition under SEAMLESS_FULL_TRACK_DEFAULT or BALANCED_MIX_RESEARCH_CONTROL.
candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_vocal_collision_trap: SYNTHETIC_EXACT: structurally plausible candidate that must be rejected specifically due to vocal_collision_risk=HIGH.
candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_valid_natural_exit: SYNTHETIC_EXACT: a candidate that is an acceptable choice under the product-default engine (region-supported, musical-unit-complete, low vocal risk, and -- as of this redesign -- near-end enough to clear the preservation floor).
candidate_ground_truth_fields.is_preferred_earliest_valid_exit: SYNTHETIC_EXACT, REDEFINED this pass: the single BEST valid candidate a non-greedy ranked planner should select -- historically named for the common case where 'best' and 'earliest-valid' coincided, but TP-12 (letter D) deliberately proves 'best' can be the LATER of two valid candidates. Field name kept for backward compatibility with run_benchmark.py's missed-opportunity metric; semantics are 'preferred', not literally 'earliest'.
candidate_ground_truth_fields.highlight_eligible: SYNTHETIC_EXACT, TP-10 only: marks the candidate that is intentionally structurally sound but preservation-gated, to isolate the HIGHLIGHT_EXPLICIT intent effect from structural evidence.

fixture_level_fields.trailing_dead_air_ms: Optional. Milliseconds of authored non-musical trailing silence after the musical content ends.
fixture_level_fields.trailing_dead_air_is_authored_non_musica: Optional, default false. Only when explicitly true does effective_content_end_ms subtract trailing_dead_air_ms from duration_ms -- an unannotated tail is NEVER silently treated as removable dead air.
fixture_level_fields.sequential_album_intent: Optional, default false. When true, FULL_DJ_BLEND and SHORT_EQ_BLEND are withheld from preferred_transition_class_set regardless of timing/pair-compatibility quality.

pair_fixture_fields.outgoing / incoming: genre_tags + bpm for each side of the pair
pair_fixture_fields.harmonic_relationship: COMPATIBLE|INCOMPATIBLE|omitted(=UNKNOWN, eligible only with a valid STRUCTURED exception -- see below)
pair_fixture_fields.harmonic_not_load_bearing_reason: REMOVED as a functional bypass by PM REVIEW #3 R7 -- the field name is no longer read anywhere in policy/compatibility.py. Retained ONLY as a regression fixture value (PAIR-11) to prove arbitrary free text is now completely inert.
pair_fixture_fields.harmonic_exception_kind: PM REVIEW #3 R7. Only consulted when harmonic_relationship is omitted/UNKNOWN. Must be one of the enumerated HARMONIC_EXCEPTION_KINDS (NON_TONAL_RHYTHMIC | PERCUSSION_ONLY | NOISE_TEXTURE) -- an unrecognized value is rejected (PAIR-13).
pair_fixture_fields.tonal_content_class: PM REVIEW #3 R7. Must equal exactly "NON_TONAL" for the exception to apply.
pair_fixture_fields.tonal_analysis_confidence: PM REVIEW #3 R7. Must be HIGH for the exception to apply (LOW/MEDIUM/NONE are rejected -- PAIR-12). ALL THREE structured fields (kind + class + confidence) must be valid simultaneously; see PAIR-09 (all three valid, eligible) vs PAIR-08 (none supplied, downgraded) vs PAIR-11/12/13 (each fails exactly one requirement).
pair_fixture_fields.structure_compatibility: COMPATIBLE|omitted(=UNKNOWN -- now a HARD-GATE failure for FULL_DJ_BLEND as of R4, see PAIR-06)
pair_fixture_fields.intro_outro_texture_compatible: bool (false/omitted is now a HARD-GATE failure for FULL_DJ_BLEND as of R4, see PAIR-07)
pair_fixture_fields.expected_overall_eligible: SYNTHETIC_EXACT test-design label consumed only by build script validation / run_benchmark.py reporting, never by policy/compatibility.py itself

pair_fixtures_pm_review_2_additions.description: structure_compatibility UNKNOWN (omitted) -- must NOT get the same FULL_DJ_BLEND eligibility as known COMPATIBLE
intro_outro_texture_compatible UNKNOWN/false -- must NOT get the same FULL_DJ_BLEND eligibility as known COMPATIBLE
harmonic_relationship UNKNOWN, no exception -- downgraded, not silently COMPATIBLE
harmonic_relationship UNKNOWN, WITH a valid STRUCTURED exception (kind + NON_TONAL class + HIGH tonal confidence, PM REVIEW #3 R7) -- eligible
harmonic_relationship INCOMPATIBLE -- always rejects FULL_DJ_BLEND, even with an exception reason present (exception only ever applies to UNKNOWN)

pair_fixtures_pm_review_3_additions.description: R7: harmonic UNKNOWN with the OLD free-text harmonic_not_load_bearing_reason field set to a non-empty string -- must NOT be eligible; the field is completely inert
R7: harmonic UNKNOWN with a valid exception kind + NON_TONAL class but tonal_analysis_confidence=LOW -- rejected; confidence is enforced, not just field presence
R7: harmonic UNKNOWN with an unrecognized harmonic_exception_kind -- rejected; the enum is enforced

note_on_ground_truth_isolation: Ground-truth-only fields (is_premature_trap, is_vocal_collision_trap, is_valid_natural_exit, is_preferred_earliest_valid_exit, highlight_eligible, expected_overall_eligible) are consumed ONLY by run_benchmark.py's scoring/metrics code and verify.py's assertions, never by policy/eligibility.py, policy/policies.py, policy/compatibility.py, or policy/ranking.py's decision logic. This separation is statically asserted by verify.py (AST-based, immune to prose mentions) so no policy can 'see the answer key'.
